# Solana by Zenterra

Design preview. Not the live Eden website. Do not index.

Solana is a condominium community by Zenterra Developments at 7687-200 Street, Langley, BC V2Y 1S3, in Willoughby.

Contact: solana@zenterra.ca, 604.243.4368.
Sales centre: 190 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley.
Head office: #216 – 2630 Croydon Drive, Surrey, BC V3Z 6T3, (778) 945-2050.

Completion 2027. Ready to move-in Spring 2027.
90,000+ sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenity space.
Homes shown on this preview: 1 and 2 bedroom floorplans B2 (Building A), B2a (Building A), B9 (Building A), B2 (Building B) and D1 (Building B).

Pricing is not published on this page.
